description:
Build keyboard-shortcut habits without interrupting your workflow. Shortcut Coach notices supported actions you perform with the mouse and shows the equivalent shortcut for next time.

Every coaching event is saved to a local inbox, so you can revisit what you learned. Choose the presentation channels that suit you, including a native notification, focused on-screen coaching, Dock feedback, and sound.

Shortcut Coach supports macOS menu commands, a conservative set of Chrome controls, standard window controls, and verified Finder-to-Trash actions. Detection uses macOS Accessibility permission and a listen-only pointer monitor. Processing and history stay on your Mac.

Features:
• Learn shortcuts at the moment they are useful
• Review durable coaching history from the menu bar
• Choose and preview presentation channels
• Control Dock and App Switcher presence
• Inspect permission and detector diagnostics
• Clear local history at any time
promotionalText: Turn everyday clicks into lasting keyboard-shortcut habits with private, on-device coaching.
whatsNew: Initial release of Shortcut Coach with local coaching history, configurable presentation channels, menu-bar access, and supported manual-action detection.
